简单的 FLUX GGUF 工作流程，作者：weshouldhaveshotguns

我的 SIMPLE FLUX DEV WORKFLOW 的 GGUF 版本旨在提供一种直接、直观的方法，通过 GGUF 量化模型在 ComfyUI 中使用 Flux。该版本专为与 Flux 的量化版本兼容而构建，经过优化，可以在具有较低 VRAM 的 GPU 上平稳运行，同时仍然保留原始工作流程的简单性和有效性。

与原始设置一样，此设置不仅运行良好，而且还可以帮助用户了解每个节点的功能及其存在的原因，从而更轻松地进行自定义和实验。此版本包括所有必需的文件、设置清单、解决方案和提示的最佳实践，以及有关 FluxGuidance、步骤和采样器等设置如何影响输出的详细指南。

GGUF 版本有何不同:

  • 量化模型支持：此版本附带检索量化 GGUF 模型的说明，包括关于哪些模型类型最适合不同 VRAM 容量的建议，允许用户针对其特定硬件优化其设置。

无论您是 AI 艺术新手还是有一定经验，这种与 GGUF 兼容的工作流程都为 Flux 提供了坚实的基础，使您能够快速精通，同时支持高级 LoRA 功能。这不是最终的工作流程——总是有更多东西需要学习——但它经过了良好的优化，经过深思熟虑的组织，并且是使用量化模型学习和创建的一个很好的起点。

v1.1 在所需文件注释中添加了可选 GGUF T5 编码器的链接

o.en:
SIMPLE FLUX GGUF WORKFLOW by weshouldhaveshotguns

This GGUF version of my SIMPLE FLUX DEV WORKFLOW is designed to provide a straightforward, intuitive approach to using Flux in ComfyUI, with GGUF-quantized models. Built for compatibility with quantized versions of Flux, this version is optimized to run smoothly on GPUs with lower VRAM, while still retaining the simplicity and effectiveness of the original workflow.

Like the original, this setup not only works well but also helps users understand what each node does and why it’s there, making it easier to customize and experiment. This version includes all the required files, a settings rundown, and best practices for resolutions and prompts, along with detailed guidance on how settings like FluxGuidance, steps, and samplers influence the output.

What’s Different in the GGUF Version:

  • Quantized Model Support: This version comes with instructions for retrieving quantized GGUF models, including recommendations for which model types best match different VRAM capacities, allowing users to optimize their setup for their specific hardware.

Whether you’re new to AI art or have some experience, this GGUF-compatible workflow provides a solid foundation in Flux, enabling you to quickly become proficient while supporting advanced LoRA capabilities. It’s not the ultimate workflow—there’s always more to learn—but it’s well-optimized, thoughtfully organized, and a great starting point for both learning and creation with quantized models.

v1.1 adds link for optional GGUF T5 encoders in required files note
